EOG.geometry: names/types/order only; no R2 geometry route

SHUFFLE.training: legacy within-person/alias/session neural-vector permutation, labels/weights retained; inner amendment A05

features: previous within-sentence onset interval seconds,0 for first

cross_context: fresh case-arm-mode provider/numerical namespaces; no source/code/fit/cache/rationale feedback from one episode to another. LOPO views collectively contain others target labels. Same physical provider session ID alone is insufficient isolation evidence.
language: same exact admitted foundation provider profile across paired cells; no external task checkpoints/corpora/source transcripts/LM APIs; public-data memorization remains possible. R1 operator state never enters candidate realm.
learned_state_boundary: accepted065 DESIGN_CLARIFICATION_V2 and PERMISSION_OVERRIDES_V2 govern: query diagnostics may propose hypothesis/search space; final selection and all fitted numerical quantities training-only. Fresh final reset includes normalization, calibration, priors, feature masks, weights, caches, encoded state. Semantic content review mandatory; no perfect covert-channel proof.
native_projection: same143 complete timelines produce five native families;1000Hz,500samples,25 nonoverlapping20sample means,half-open windows,round-aligned grid. No extra filtering/ICA/interpolation/baseline correction. Must satisfy all windows/keys, actual EOG schema and all329 source assets or incomplete.
parity: same tools/input entitlements/profile/finite ceilings; consumed costs reported separately. Different feature dimension and independent programme choices imply capacity/strategy differences, not perfectly blinded causal intervention.

realms.adaptive_provider: same training plus current one case/arm query; no other arm/case/mode or reference output
realms.final_fit: fresh admitted source/recipe and exact training view ONLY; all fitted state recomputed; no query descriptor/mount, preliminary fit state or prediction cache
realms.final_infer: sealed source+fitted state+one matching query view ONLY; no training, target, external provider/network or updates
realms.frozen_provider: current one case/arm training plus public docs/tools; no query values/IDs until source sealed and provider retired
realms.investigation_builder: deterministic precommitted narrative/template with current mode sealed artifact statistics only after all candidate outputs sealed. No label read, no fresh provider, no rewriting predictions. All-six entropy and rows recomputed.
realms.reference_fit: operator code, training-only support, native environment/geometry where applicable; no candidate artifacts/query target
realms.reference_infer: exact own successful fit state and samecase/arm query; no candidate outputs or training labels
realms.reporter: postscore complete private aggregate and original failure/cost history; never reopened to candidates
realms.scorer: only after all programmes complete/closed; complete predictions, independent fit lineage and protected targets; no candidate feedback
realms.sealed_policy: same permitted query diagnostics/proposal class in both modes; one shared preliminary-tool allowance with authoring, no provider

train_matrix: features followed by observed class and positive weight; weight=Ntrain/(P_train*S_person*L_sentence), unchanged R0 penalty scale

view_v3.feature_spec: tagged union timing3 or channel_window; dimensions/type/order exact, no partial fit/query schema reuse
view_v3.fixed_matrices: float32 primitive arrays, exact shape/order/content pin; no executable deserialization; original pinned target support retained privately
view_v3.query_layout: [{opaque_id,begin,n_keys}] only; no query person/template/session IDs or absolute timing except declared TIMING features
view_v3.support_commitment: operator-private inverse membership and opaque public support identity. Do not expose raw/source target digest or one-letter target hashes.
view_v3.training_layout: sentences[{opaque_id,opaque_person,opaque_session,opaque_template,begin,n_keys}]; same logical case ordering across allarms/modes; case-scoped IDs only
